role: @MainActor @Observable holder of morning-processing UI state split out of RRCollector: morning pipeline status, device-fetch flag, recovered-workout review, and HealthKit sleep/vitals change counters.
types: MorningCoordination: class (@MainActor @Observable final) — morning/results coordination state
MorningCoordination.RecoveredWorkoutReview: struct — crash-recovered workout awaiting review (sessionId, sport, durationSec, distanceMeters, avgHR)
toplevel: Stored-property defaults only: morningStatus nil, isDeviceFetchInProgress false, recoveredWorkoutReview nil, sleepDataVersion 0, vitalsDataVersion 0. No units.

flags.text: vitalsDataVersion is written (RRCollector+Bindings.swift:195) but no code reads MorningCoordination.vitalsDataVersion; its doc says views observe it to re-fetch vitals and re-archive the snapshot so SleepDetailView is not blank, and the named reader RecoveryDashboardView no longer exists, so that refresh trigger does nothing.
